subject: Lumenix: post-upgrade latency spike + quality dip (quant profile v2)
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@lumenix.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: kate.miller@lumenix.com
Date: 2026-08-02T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: production model upgrade completed — immediate issues

Rafael,

We flipped to the v5.2 model with the new quant profile (v2) during last night's maintenance window. Since ~02:00 UTC we're seeing: a) median latency up ~3x for our short prompts, b) a jump in 5xx rates from 0.2% -> 4.5%, and c) ~8% of outputs are hallucinating product SKUs incorrectly. This is blocking our checkout flow for a subset of traffic.

We've captured traces and a small set of failing examples (attached). Can you confirm rollback options or an emergency mitigation? This is impacting a live cohort (US-East).

Sanjay
Ops Lead, Lumenix
From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@lumenix.com>, Claire Huang <claire@lumenix.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-02T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: production model upgrade completed — immediate issues

Sanjay — thanks for the ping and for the attachments. I'm escalating immediately. Internal folks looped.

Short answers up front: we can (1) trigger an immediate rollback to the v5.1 artifact and quant profile v1, (2) enable the legacy routing policy to route Lumenix traffic to the stable pool while we investigate, or (3) apply a temporary throttle to long-context requests if that's contributing.

Can you confirm whether the failing requests are all coming from your es-checkout service (service-id: checkout-us-east)? If so please share a few request IDs; we'll pull traces. I'm proposing an emergency call in 30 minutes.

—Rafael
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@lumenix.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T10:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: production model upgrade completed — immediate issues

Adding quick triage notes (initial):
- Reproduced increased p50/p95 for short prompts against v5.2+quant-v2 on our internal bench with same prompt samples.
- Error logs show a rise in OOM-retry loops on certain host groups (worker-az-east-3). Retry storm correlates with elevated 5xx.
- Quant profile v2 looks to have aggressive kernel packing for int8 that changes memory layout; I see orphaned caches not being reclaimed between sessions in the new runtime path.

Attachments: perf_snapshot_20260802.csv, quant_profile_v2.json, error_sample_20260802.txt

Plan suggestion: roll Lumenix back to v5.1+quant-v1 on their routing tag, enable debug tracing for 1% of traffic, and schedule a focused root cause slot with runtime team. If customers approve, I can trigger the rollback now.

-Monica
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@lumenix.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: production model upgrade completed — immediate issues

Short technical note: Monica's findings align with a kernel selection regression we saw in canaries last week under specific sequence-length distributions. Two immediate mitigations (in order):
1) Rollback routing tag (fastest, tested).
2) If rollback risks capacity contention, enable fallback to v5.1 only for the Lumenix customer group (we can hot-route) and bump CPU-side throttles to smooth retries.

I will reserve the runtime team for a 2-hour deep-dive starting 14:00 UTC today. If we do rollback, we should also capture the failing hosts (worker-az-east-3) for postmortem.

-Markus
Head of Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Claire Huang <claire@lumenix.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@lumenix.com>, kate.miller@lumenix.com
Date: 2026-08-03T08:13:00-07:00
Subject: Re: production model upgrade completed — immediate issues

Rafael — this is now an executive-level incident on our side. Our PMs report checkout conversion down 12% for the impacted cohort. Kate (procurement) is asking whether this upgrade had any contractual impacts and whether we need a credit for the downtime window. We need an exec sync with your leadership and a firm timeline for rollback + verification.

Please include an SLA impact estimate and whether rollback will restore prior behavior in full. We need action within the next 6 hours.

Thanks,
Claire
VP, Product Operations, Lumenix
From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: Claire Huang <claire@lumenix.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@lumenix.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-04T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: production model upgrade completed — immediate issues

Claire / Sanjay — thank you and apologies for the disruption. Executive sync confirmed for 18:00 UTC today with our Head of Product and VP Customer Success.

Immediate actions we've committed to:
- Rollback Lumenix traffic to v5.1 + quant-v1 now (target completion 18:30 UTC).
- Post-rollback smoke tests (p95 latency, inference-error-rate, sample correctness) run for 60 minutes; we will share a pass/fail dashboard link.
- If rollback restores baseline, we'll open a formal RFC for the v5.2+quant-v2 path with extra canary checks, kernel pinning, and an extended canary window.
- POC: if rollback does not fully restore correctness, Redwood will provide a credit calculation and a remediation timeline.

Links: JIRA-RED-1298 (incident), zoom: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=abc123
Attachments included in thread for your reference.

I'll send status updates every 30 minutes during the operation.

—Rafael
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
